cohort: 103 pregnant women with pre-gestational or gestational diabetes mellitus admitted for prenatal care to the department of gynecology and obstetrics of Jame Zanan hospital (Tehran, Iran) in 2015.
finding: UA Doppler test results were significantly related to hypoglycemia, RDS, low Apgar scores, and NICU admission, while MCA Doppler results were significantly associated with RDS and neonatal death.
